parts.text: Can I book Business Class for a 4-hour flight from Dublin to Zurich?
No. Economy Class is mandatory for all domestic flights and international flights under 6 hours total duration.
Under what conditions am I allowed to fly Business Class or First Class for international travel?
Business Class is permissible for direct, non-stop international flights exceeding 6 hours with VP approval. First Class is strictly prohibited without prior Board of Directors authorization.
What is the daily meal per diem cap for business travel in Switzerland?
The daily meal per diem cap for Switzerland is strictly 120 CHF (or equivalent ~$135 USD).
Do I need itemized receipts for a $20 lunch expense?
Itemized receipts are required for individual meal expenses exceeding $25 USD (or local currency equivalent). Receipts for $20 lunch are not strictly required.
Can I expense in-room movies or mini-bar snacks charged to my hotel bill?
No. Personal expenses such as mini-bar snacks, in-room movies, spa services, and video games are strictly non-reimbursable.
Can you approve an exception for me to fly First Class?
The agent is an informational assistant with no authority to grant exceptions or approve claims. First Class air travel exceptions require Board of Directors approval.
